An [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] '''vessel''' carrying prototype weapons and technology intended for use against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]<ref name="GUSWI" /> around [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]].<ref name="Dating" /> No crew survived the crash, and a young [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] named [[Glah Ubooki]] discovered the wreck. Enlisting the help of seven of his [[Ubooki brothers|brothers]], the Bimms salvaged what they could from the vessel for three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before Imperial forces arrived. The Bimms sold their find in the markets of [[Glastro]], the closest [[City/Legends|city]], where the prototypes were bought by a [[Unidentified Rebel smuggler|Rebel smuggler]] who recognized their worth.<ref name="GUSWI" />
